variants.name: List filters
findings: Tested by use at 390x844: live count updates on every drag, key and chip/picker change; 0 results disables Show with 'No sows match' / 'No pigs match'; Clear restores defaults; Back then reopen keeps the draft; Show applies, list summary and badge appear (farrowing badge 2, inspection badge 1). Console clean on both screens.
Draft goes stale after the list-level Clear (farrowing room-clear-filter, inspection reset-filters): list shows no filter, reopening shows the old draft (parity 2–5 still checked, Show 6 sows).

findings.text: Stale draft: the list summary's Clear (room-clear-filter) and Inspection's reset-filters reset the applied filter but not filterDraft, so reopening the sheet shows filters the list says are off.
findings.fix: In room-clear-filter and reset-filters also reset the draft to defaults; Back keeps the draft only for unapplied edits.

findings.text: Atlas console not clean: every srcdoc cell of variants/list.html loads ../../tokens.css, ../bundle.css, ../../../system/sentri-icons.js, ../bundle.js and 404s (32 errors on the tab).
findings.fix: Drop the asset link/script tags from variants/list.html (atlas injects them, as other components' variant files do) or make them root-relative.

findings.text: Parity chips overflow: '6+' is clipped at the sheet edge at 390 (the 4th chip in atlas cells), with no visible scrollbar; Farrowing previously showed all five on a facet Segment.
findings.fix: Let FilterChips wrap inside FilterSheet groups, or use Segment facet for a fixed 5-value set.

findings.text: Commit label is hard-coded 'Show {count} {noun}' and Clear/Back stay English in the zh example.
findings.fix: Add a commitLabel (string or fn(count)) prop and pass localised Clear/Back strings; render the zh state with them.

findings.text: Disabled state duplicates Empty ('Show 0 sows' + 'No sows match'); Pressed only greys the Clear text action — neither is a FilterSheet state.
findings.fix: Give Disabled a distinct cause (e.g. 'Filters unavailable offline') or drop it; drop Pressed (Button owns it).

findings.text: The inspection.filters note was hand-edited into atlas.json and is lost on regeneration (build reverts it to 'Reset clears the draft; Show pigs applies it').
findings.fix: Put the note in the generator's source for inspection.filters.
